declared.floor_rule: floor = equal-weight mean of available floor families' lam (canonical gauss composed with lam_K); band = [min, max] of their point estimates
declared.coin_rule: PASS iff 95% hierarchical-bootstrap CI of (dCoin_obs - dCoin_pred) contains 0
declared.c_rule: c reported only if the lam 2.5% bound > 0.10, else 'unidentified'
declared.pooling: equal-weight mean over models having both families; per-model hierarchical bootstraps are independent and combined replicate-wise (stratified bootstrap, strata = models); inverse-variance weights as sensitivity
declared.bootstrap: per replicate: tasks resampled (shared by all families + null), U null draws resampled (shared), each family: checkpoints with replacement then draws within checkpoint with replacement
declared.holm: Holm at alpha 0.05 over every test in 'holm_family' (pooled tests + per-model c contrasts)
declared.declaration_status: declared in this script before its first run on snapshot 20260929T1937Z; NOT a pre-registration: the reviewer and the team had seen ungated q4/q8/q14 numbers
